resources.title: HTTP Semantics
resources.reason: Supports deterministic Date generation and the distinction between a UTC clock and a monotonic timeout clock.
locators: 5.6.7 Date/Time Formats (generation requirement and UTC definition)

inspection.method: Root inspection of official RFC web identity and captured official RFC text
inspection.scope: Complete Date subsection; Date/Time Formats opening through IMF-fixdate generation, UTC and clock definitions. The official text capture was inspected locally, not a third-party tutorial.
inspection.limits: No timestamp-recipient implementation, NTP, obsolete-date parsing or complete HTTP semantics claim. The lab generates a Date field with an injected fixture clock; timeout scheduling uses a separate monotonic clock.
